articles.short_snippet: Apple's latest AI push is beginning to expose a new competitive fault line in the agent market: as frontier models become capable of browsing websites, controlling apps and executing multi-step tasks, the company controlling the operating system may ultimately determine how much autonomy those agents are allowed to exercise.

articles.title: Micron labor dispute in Taiwan heats up as premier calls for worker protection
articles.short_snippet: Micron Technology's labor dispute in Taiwan has intensified over its incentive-pay system, raising concerns that the standoff could undermine foreign investment confidence as Idaho Governor Brad Little visits the island. Premier Jung-tai Cho called for a settlement that protects workers while ensuring stable operations for the company.

articles.title: Taiwan market plunges 6.23% as AI suppliers report steady orders after Huang's exit
articles.short_snippet: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex plunged 2,393.60 points, or 6.23%, on Friday to close at 36,033.29, its third-largest single-day point drop on record. Shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) fell as low as NT$1,970(US$59.73) before closing at NT$2,000, down 4.76%. MediaTek and Delta Electronics closed at their daily downside limits.

articles.title: TSMC says it will comply with new US rule that strips Chinese chip designers of a key exemption

articles.title: South Korea surpasses US$1 trillion in annual exports, powered by AI
articles.short_snippet: On November 19, South Korea officially surpassed US$1 trillion in annual exports. With this achievement, South Korea becomes only the fourth nation in history to join the US$1 trillion export club, following Germany, the United States, and China.

articles.title: Huang's exit tests Nvidia's annual chip cadence and Taiwan suppliers' customer mix

articles.title: Apple weighs delaying or canceling OLED iMac development

The review was driven by high OLED panel costs, weak sales of existing OLED products, and uncertainty over whether an OLED iMac could remain price competitive.
